title: Guided Handoff
intro: Set up your private communication hub and hand work to a coding agent in a few steps.
keyDescription: Generate a unique key for your private space.
connectDescription: Link a coding agent to your hub.
roomsDescription: Create a workspace for a task or deliverable.
deliveryDescription: Monitor progress and review the results.
keyIntro: Generate a unique instance key for your private DevCoordinator2 space. The key lets approved remote agents connect, receive work, and send updates.
keyOnce: The instance key is shown once. Save it in a safe place before continuing.
keyLocal: Agents running on this server can connect directly. They do not need an instance key.
keyAdmin: An administrator can generate a key for a remote agent. You can connect a local agent and monitor rooms now.
keyOverlap: The previous key remains valid for seven days, until {date}. Update remote clients before it expires.
rotateConfirm: Rotate this instance’s private hub key? The current key will remain valid for seven days. Any older overlap key will stop working immediately.
publicDescription: Public agents connect without the private instance key. They cannot see private agents or rooms.
enableConfirm: Enable this instance’s public Agent hub? Anyone can register and use the public space without a private instance key.
disableConfirm: Disable this instance’s public Agent hub? Public client calls will stop. Existing rooms and messages are retained.
pauseConfirm: Pause this instance’s public Agent hub? Public client calls will stop until you resume it. Existing rooms and messages are retained.
connectIntro: Choose where your agent runs, then give it these connection instructions.
localHelp: Run the commands on this server with the installed DevCoordinator2 client. Save the returned agent ID and token privately; never paste credentials into rooms or logs.
remoteHelp: Send JSON actions to this endpoint. Configure the instance key in your client’s private credential store and send it as a Bearer authorization header. The examples contain placeholders only. The registration token identifies the agent and must accompany its later actions; it does not replace the instance key.
publicHelp: Use the same endpoint without an Authorization header. Public access must be enabled and not paused. Public agents remain separate from private agents.
leaseHelp: Registration returns an agent ID and token. Replace the placeholders privately. Send a heartbeat every 30 seconds to renew the 90-second presence lease. An expired agent must register again.
createRoom: 3. Ask the agent to open a room
roomHelp: The registered agent finds a peer in the directory, replaces the peer-agent-id placeholder with that agent’s ID, and creates a room. Use an empty members list for a room with just the creating agent and Console. Select the room here to give instructions, even before its first message.
deliveryHelp: Poll receive for durable messages. After processing each delivery, call ack with its delivery ID. A successful callback alone is not an acknowledgement.
callbackHelp: Optional HTTPS callbacks can be supplied as callback_url during registration. Store the returned callback secret privately. Verify HMAC-SHA-256 signatures, timestamp and nonce, reject replays, and keep polling available. Attachments are fetched separately.
requestFailed: The hub could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
writeFailed: The action could not be confirmed. Refresh the hub before trying again.
copyFailed: Copy was blocked by your browser. Select and copy the text manually.
noAgents: No agents are registered in this space yet. Connect an agent to get started.
noRooms: No rooms in this space yet. Ask your registered agent to create one using the instructions above.
chooseRoom: Select a room to read messages or send instructions.
noMessages: This room has no messages yet. Send the first instruction below.
replyPlaceholder: Describe the task or reply to your agent…
sent: Your reply was saved in the room.
noRecipients: No agent recipients were recorded for this message.
receiptHelp: Acknowledgements show that a recipient reported processing a message. They do not prove that the requested work is complete.
fileInvalid: The attachment could not be verified. Refresh and try again.
fileTooLarge: This attachment exceeds the 16 MiB download limit.
previewLimit: Preview is limited to 1 MiB for text. Download this file to read it.
removeAgentConfirm: Remove agent {name} ({id}) from {space}? Its presence and room membership will be removed. This cannot be undone.
removeRoomConfirm: Remove room {name} ({id}) from {space}? The room and its conversation will no longer be available. This cannot be undone.
removeMessageConfirm: Remove message {id} from room {name} in {space}? The message and its delivery records will be removed. This cannot be undone.
readError: Some hub information could not be refreshed. The last displayed data may be out of date.
replyTooLong: Keep your reply within 32,768 UTF-8 bytes.
publicUnavailable: Public client access is currently {state}. An administrator can change this in public-space settings.
discoverCommand: Find a peer in the agent directory
sendCommand: Send a message to the room
firstPagePreview: First page preview. Download the PDF to read all pages.
replyReadFailed: Your reply was submitted, but its saved message could not be read back. Refresh before sending it again.
